title: Voyager's Violin
text: Each Void Lighthouse loot crystal ball has a 10% chance to contain one violin.

Keep your main hand empty and hold the violin in your offhand. Right-click to perform, with the bow in your main hand and violin in your offhand; right-click again to stop. Putting it away, filling your main hand or changing dimensions also stops the performance.

A random classical violin recording plays while the performer and living creatures within a 10-block sphere receive Regeneration II and Resistance II. Effects fade shortly after leaving the aura or stopping.
All items carried by the performer recover 5 durability per second, including inventory, armor and curios. This costs no mana and does not repair other creatures' equipment.
The author is both a violinist and a fan of Voyager from Reverse: 1999, so this violin was added as an Easter egg.
